name: Inland Printers Limited
summary: Inland Printers Ltd. engages in the e-commerce business of printing stationery. It produces and markets printed products including memorandum and articles of association, annual reports, dividend warrants, interest warrants, continuous stationery and computer forms, prospectuses and other documents, corporate profiles, application and business forms, brochures, publicity material, product literature and books. The company was founded on November 3, 1978 and is headquartered in Mumbai, India.
